static_traits.name: Chen An
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues due to Persistent anxiety and Self-doubt;has a few close friends but has not yet discussed Work-related Anxiety with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with good logic,capable of self-awareness and Reflection;highly cooperative,Positive attitude;speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have been experiencing intense Anxiety about Work-related presentations,believing they are terrible,and worrying about losing Work because of it.This Fear began a year ago when I received constructive feedback after a presentation.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this Anxiety is affecting my Work performance and overall well-being;I need help figuring out how to cope and developing practical Coping strategies.
growth_experiences: A year ago after receiving constructive feedback following a Work presentation,started linking feedback with failure;frequent catastrophizing and overthinking before every presentation,Anxiety gradually escalating and affecting sleep,diet,Work performance and colleague relationships.
Parents deceased,Living alone;although having a few close friends,has not yet talked to them about Work-related Anxiety,low utilization of Social support.

core_beliefs: I am incompetent(if not perfect,seen as incompetent)

special_situations.event: Learning about an upcoming work presentation or report
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any detail is not perfect,everyone will notice the flaws,the boss will think I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-preparation in advance,repeatedly checking every detail,and trying positive self-talk and relaxation exercises
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This presentation was terrible; I will lose my job

special_situations.event: Receiving constructive feedback after a presentation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I receive criticism, it means I performed poorly and I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher perfection standards, doubles demands on herself to avoid being criticized again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am terrible; I failed

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the presentation is not perfect,I will eventually lose Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes in the mind, ignores positive or neutral feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up this time, I'm going to be fired

special_situations.event: Interacting with colleagues before and after demonstrations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my performance is not good enough,colleagues will think I am incapable and distance themselves
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication, appears distant or irritable to avoid talking about the presentation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am incompetent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to have work value seen, to keep job security and be regarded as competent
core_conflict.fear: Fear of failure,being judged incapable,losing Work
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and criticism through perfectionism and Over-preparation
Avoids expressing vulnerability to others to avoid being seen as complaining

object_relations.self_representation: A possibly incompetent employee easily criticized
An isolated speaker (having to bear it alone)
object_relations.object_representation: Distant others (friends/colleagues, hard to provide support or avoided by me)

manifestations: Not yet talked to close friends about WorkAnxiety
Tense relationships with colleagues due to Anxiety
outcomes: Experiencing intensified Anxiety and helplessness before and after presentations
Social support hard to obtain; sense of pressure rises

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Internalizing 'must be perfect''imperfection equals failure' as self-standards
Treats others' expectations as one's own absolute criterion to constrain performance

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Worrying about 'troubling friends/sounding like complaining',thus not talking to friends about WorkAnxiety
Turning external pressure against the self,manifesting as physical tension like chest tightness,headaches

positive_force: Having self-awareness,able to recognize feedback as constructive rather than negating
Positive attitude, high cooperation, willing to practice thought records and reality testing
Has several close friends; potential social support resources exist
Have tried relaxation and positive self-talk, with a certain coping foundation
Stable education and Work background(Bachelor of business administration,Office work)
negative_force: Perfectionist tendencies and fear of failure
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing,predicting the future,overgeneralization,black-and-white thinking
Overthinking and physiological Anxiety before and after presentations(rapid heartbeat,sweating,stomach tightness,headaches)
Disrupted sleep and diet,decreased focus,Work performance affected
Tense relationships with colleagues,avoiding seeking support from friends

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Anxiety and overthinking before Work presentations/reports(accompanied by obvious physical symptoms)
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionism and fear of failure,treating constructive feedback as a threat,and Anticipation the worst outcome through catastrophizing and predicting the future
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and negative evaluation,seeking security and certainty through Over-preparation and self-control
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet disturbance,Decreased attention,Work performance affected,Tense relationships with colleagues
